boot-kind:
; Image startup's declaration. Configuration is a trusted startup input;
; external image octets stay in bounded pool windows and are never read as Lisp.
(in-package "ACL2")
(include-book "machines-b")
(include-book "machine-arms")
(include-book "boot-format")
(include-book "boot-config-state")
(fn2-book-layer :b)

; Only startup configuration has a list cursor. It advances one group per
; visit, is cleared before ready, and never contains parsed device data.
; Its resident measure (T10) is declared at the boot record's widths: each of
; the COUNT genesis groups as a name at the identity field's 250 octets (the
; most fn2-boot-pack-pool writes) and a u60 value in 8 bytes; the path at
; *fn2-profile-path-identity-max* octets. COUNT is fixed at init, so the
; measure is too while the cursor advances.



(defun fn2-boot-config-prepare (profile fn2-boot-config)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-boot-config :guard t))
 (let* ((fn2-boot-config (fn2-boot-config-empty 0 fn2-boot-config))
        (groups (fn2-profile-get :groups profile))
        (extents (fn2-b-capacity :extent-slots 16 profile))
        (owner (fn2-profile-get :owner-account profile)))
  (if (not (fn2-profile-get :image-boot profile)) fn2-boot-config
   (let* ((fn2-boot-config (update-fn2-boot-config-groups groups fn2-boot-config))
          (fn2-boot-config (update-fn2-boot-config-recovery-assumptions (fn2-profile-recovery-assumptions profile) fn2-boot-config))
          (fn2-boot-config (update-fn2-boot-config-path (fn2-profile-path-identity profile) fn2-boot-config))
          (fn2-boot-config (update-fn2-boot-config-count (if (unsigned-byte-p 32 (len groups)) (len groups) 0) fn2-boot-config))
          (fn2-boot-config (update-fn2-boot-config-extents (if (unsigned-byte-p 32 extents) extents 0) fn2-boot-config))
          (fn2-boot-config (update-fn2-boot-config-owner (if (and (posp owner) (unsigned-byte-p 32 owner)) owner 1) fn2-boot-config))
          (fn2-boot-config (update-fn2-boot-config-authority (if (posp (nfix (fn2-profile-get :authority profile))) 1 0) fn2-boot-config)))
     fn2-boot-config))))
(defthm fn2-boot-config-prepare-type
 (implies (fn2-boot-configp fn2-boot-config)
          (fn2-boot-configp (fn2-boot-config-prepare profile fn2-boot-config)))
 :hints (("Goal" :in-theory (disable fn2-profile-recovery-assumptions fn2-profile-get
                                    fn2-profile-path-identity unsigned-byte-p posp nfix))))
(defthm fn2-boot-config-prepare-wfp (fn2-boot-config-wfp (fn2-boot-config-prepare profile fn2-boot-config))
 :hints (("Goal" :in-theory (disable fn2-profile-recovery-assumptions fn2-profile-get
                                    fn2-profile-path-identity unsigned-byte-p posp nfix))))
(defthm fn2-boot-config-prepare-recovery-assumptions
 (implies (fn2-profile-get :image-boot profile)
  (equal (fn2-boot-config-recovery-assumptions (fn2-boot-config-prepare profile fn2-boot-config))
         (fn2-profile-recovery-assumptions profile)))
 :hints (("Goal" :in-theory (disable fn2-profile-recovery-assumptions fn2-profile-get
                                    fn2-profile-path-identity unsigned-byte-p posp nfix))))
(in-theory (disable fn2-boot-config-prepare))
(defcorechild fn2-core-boot-config fn2-boot-config
 :init (fn2-boot-config-prepare profile fn2-boot-config)
 :profilep (unsigned-byte-p 32 (len (fn2-profile-get :groups profile)))
 :why "Immutable genesis verification advances a trusted configuration cursor before serving.")

(defmachine fn2-boot
 :states (:free :prepare :write :write-result :read :read-result :verify :advance
          :anchor :recover :recover-wait :epoch :epoch-fence :epoch-result :release :ready :failed)
 :fields ((pending :u32) (stopped :bool) (pool-slot :u32) (pool-gen :u60)
          (rx-slot :u32) (rx-gen :u60) (create :bool) (image-size :u60)
          (base :u60) (total :u32) (index :u32) (stage :u8) (offset :u60)
          (epoch0 :u60) (epoch1 :u60) (next-epoch :u60) (anchor-slot :bool)
          (event-ready :bool) (outcome :u8) (count :u32) (release-index :u32))
 :holds ((:prepare :storage-window) (:write :storage-window) (:write-result :storage-window)
         (:read :storage-window) (:read-result :storage-window) (:verify :storage-window)
         (:advance :storage-window) (:anchor :storage-window) (:recover :storage-window)
         (:recover-wait :storage-window) (:epoch :storage-window) (:epoch-fence :storage-window)
         (:epoch-result :storage-window))
 :budget (:bytes 32768 :steps 32 :descriptors 4)
 :stops (:geometry :configuration :io :anchor :recovery :epoch :bounds)
 :capacity (if (fn2-profile-get :image-boot profile) 1 0)
 :initial ((generation fn2-commit-initial-generation) (ready-prev *fn2-none*) (ready-next *fn2-none*))
 :arms ((:free) (:prepare) (:write) (:write-result) (:read) (:read-result) (:verify) (:advance)
        (:anchor) (:recover) (:recover-wait) (:epoch) (:epoch-fence) (:epoch-result) (:release) (:ready) (:failed))
 :observes ((:read-result) (:write-result) (:fence-result)))
boot:
; Boot's operations and arms. Instantiated after B's recovery and C's replay.
(in-package "ACL2")
(include-book "boot-kind")
(include-book "boot-pack")
(include-book "machines-a-access")
(fn2-book-layer :b)

(defcost fn2-boot-pack :answers t :bytes 12288
 :tables (fn2-core-pool fn2-core-fields fn2-core-digests fn2-core-b3)
 :doc "Encode one genesis or epoch unit and its BLAKE3, from trusted configuration scalars.")
(defcost fn2-boot-match :answers (:ok :different :bounds) :bytes 8192
 :doc "Compare an image unit to its canonical generated encoding, including its BLAKE3.")
(defcost fn2-boot-pop-config :answers (:ok :bounds) :tables (fn2-core-boot-config)
 :doc "Advance exactly one trusted configuration group after its image unit matches or completes.")
(defcost fn2-boot-read-epoch :answers (:ok :bounds :format) :bytes 4096 :tables (fn2-core-fields)
 :doc "Decode a candidate epoch; it has no authority until the whole unit matches a canonical hashed record.")
(defcost fn2-boot-check-anchor :answers t :bytes 24576
 :tables (fn2-core-pool fn2-core-fields fn2-core-digests fn2-core-b3)
 :doc "Decode the epoch and compare the entire anchor to its canonical generated, BLAKE3-covered record.")
(defcost fn2-boot-recover :answers t :tables (fn2-recovery-machine-table fn2-core-pool fn2-core-digests fn2-core-control)
 :doc "Prepare recovery under the declared startup storage fault contract and no external witness; return its row for :wake-row.")
(defcost fn2-boot-recovered :answers (:more :ok :failed) :doc "Observe completion and classification of the real recovery/replay machine.")
(defcost fn2-boot-select-epoch :answers (:ok :bounds) :doc "Choose above both persisted epoch anchors and recovery's allocator epoch.")
(defcost fn2-boot-adopt-epoch :answers t :tables (fn2-core-extents)
 :doc "Begin allocation in the new epoch only after its successful image Fence.")
(defcost fn2-boot-release-listener :answers (:more :ok :bounds)
 :doc "Select one listener after boot's epoch fence; the arm releases it through :wake-row.")
(defcost fn2-boot-release-windows :answers t :tables (fn2-core-pool fn2-core-control)
 :effects ((:release (:storage-window)))
 :doc "Release both startup windows after their last fence; neither is lent now.")

(defmacro fn2-boot-operations ()
 '(progn
 (defun fn2-boot-pack (kind index size epoch slot gen scratch sgen id ogen fn2-core)
  (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-core :guard (fn2-core-wfp fn2-core)))
  (stobj-let ((fn2-origin (fn2-core-origin fn2-core))
              (fn2-boot-config (fn2-core-boot-config fn2-core))
              (fn2-fields (fn2-core-fields fn2-core)) (fn2-digests (fn2-core-digests fn2-core))
              (fn2-b3 (fn2-core-b3 fn2-core)) (fn2-pool (fn2-core-pool fn2-core)))
   (code fn2-fields fn2-digests fn2-b3 fn2-pool)
   (let* ((lineage (fn2-origin-lineage fn2-origin))
          (domain (fn2-origin-domain fn2-origin))
          (incarnation (fn2-origin-incarnation fn2-origin))
          (history (fn2-origin-history fn2-origin))
          (history-incarnation (fn2-origin-history-incarnation fn2-origin))
          (gs (fn2-boot-config-groups fn2-boot-config))
          (text (cond ((equal kind 0) (fn2-boot-config-path fn2-boot-config))
                      ((and (equal kind 1) (consp gs) (consp (car gs))) (caar gs)) (t "")))
          (value (if (and (equal kind 1) (consp gs) (consp (car gs))) (cdar gs) 0)))
    (fn2-boot-pack-pool kind index size (fn2-boot-config-extents fn2-boot-config)
      (fn2-boot-config-count fn2-boot-config) (fn2-boot-config-owner fn2-boot-config)
      (fn2-boot-config-authority fn2-boot-config) text value epoch lineage domain incarnation history history-incarnation slot gen scratch sgen *fn2-boot-kind* id ogen
      fn2-fields fn2-digests fn2-b3 fn2-pool))
   (mv code fn2-core)))
 (fn2-core-preserves fn2-boot-pack (kind index size epoch slot gen scratch sgen id ogen fn2-core) :position 1 :rows nil)

 (defun fn2-boot-match (slot gen rx rgen id ogen fn2-core)
  (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-core :guard (fn2-core-wfp fn2-core)))
  (mv-let (code result at) (fn2-core-compare slot gen 0 *fn2-boot-kind* id ogen
                           rx rgen 0 *fn2-boot-kind* id ogen 4096 fn2-core)
   (declare (ignore at))
   (cond ((not (eq code :ok)) :bounds) ((eq result :equal) :ok) (t :different))))

 (defun fn2-boot-pop-config (index fn2-core)
  (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-core :guard (fn2-core-wfp fn2-core)))
  (stobj-let ((fn2-boot-config (fn2-core-boot-config fn2-core))) (code fn2-boot-config)
   (let ((gs (fn2-boot-config-groups fn2-boot-config)))
    (cond ((equal index 0) (mv :ok fn2-boot-config))
          ((consp gs)
        (let ((fn2-boot-config (update-fn2-boot-config-groups (cdr gs) fn2-boot-config))) (mv :ok fn2-boot-config)))
          (t (mv :bounds fn2-boot-config))))
   (mv code fn2-core)))
 (fn2-core-preserves fn2-boot-pop-config (index fn2-core) :position 1 :rows nil)

 (defun fn2-boot-read-epoch (slot gen id ogen fn2-core)
  (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-core :guard (fn2-core-wfp fn2-core)))
  (stobj-let ((fn2-fields (fn2-core-fields fn2-core)) (fn2-pool (fn2-core-pool fn2-core))) (code epoch fn2-fields)
   (if (and (<= (+ 256 *fn2-boot-record-num-fields*) (fn2-fields-rows fn2-fields))
            (unsigned-byte-p 32 slot) (unsigned-byte-p 60 gen) (unsigned-byte-p 32 id) (unsigned-byte-p 60 ogen))
     (mv-let (code end fn2-fields) (fn2-boot-record-decode 256 slot gen 0 4064 *fn2-boot-kind* id ogen fn2-fields fn2-pool)
      (declare (ignore end))
      (mv (if (eq code :ok) :ok :format) (nfix (fn2-fields-value (+ 256 *fn2-boot-record-field-epoch*) fn2-fields)) fn2-fields))
    (mv :bounds 0 fn2-fields))
   (mv code epoch fn2-core)))
 (fn2-core-preserves fn2-boot-read-epoch (slot gen id ogen fn2-core) :position 2 :rows nil)

 (defun fn2-boot-check-anchor (index size slot gen rx rgen id ogen fn2-core)
  (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-core :guard (fn2-core-wfp fn2-core)))
  (b* (((mv code epoch fn2-core) (fn2-boot-read-epoch rx rgen id ogen fn2-core))
       ((unless (eq code :ok)) (mv code 0 fn2-core))
       ((mv code fn2-core) (fn2-boot-pack 2 index size epoch slot gen rx rgen id ogen fn2-core))
       ((unless (eq code :ok)) (mv code 0 fn2-core)))
   (mv (fn2-boot-match slot gen rx rgen id ogen fn2-core) epoch fn2-core)))
 (fn2-core-preserves fn2-boot-check-anchor (index size slot gen rx rgen id ogen fn2-core) :position 2 :rows nil)

 (defun fn2-boot-recover (fn2-core)
  (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-core :guard (fn2-core-wfp fn2-core)))
  (let ((target (fn2-machine-kind-base *fn2-recovery-machine-kind* fn2-core))
        (assume (stobj-let ((fn2-boot-config (fn2-core-boot-config fn2-core))) (assume)
                  (fn2-boot-config-recovery-assumptions fn2-boot-config) assume)))
   (mv-let (code fn2-core) (fn2-recovery-prepare target assume 0 fn2-core)
    (mv code target fn2-core))))
 (fn2-core-preserves fn2-boot-recover (fn2-core) :position 2 :rows nil)
 (defun fn2-boot-recovered (fn2-core)
  (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-core :guard (fn2-core-wfp fn2-core)))
  (let ((id (fn2-machine-kind-base *fn2-recovery-machine-kind* fn2-core)))
   (cond ((not (eq (fn2-recovery-machine-snapshot-read-code id fn2-core) :ok)) :failed)
         ((not (equal (fn2-machine-phase id fn2-core) *fn2-recovery-machine-state-done*)) :more)
         ((member (fn2-machine-rc-class id fn2-core) (list *fn2-rec-class-intact* *fn2-rec-class-torn-tail*)) :ok)
         (t :failed))))
 (defun fn2-boot-select-epoch (e0 e1 fn2-core)
  (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-core :guard (fn2-core-wfp fn2-core)))
  (stobj-let ((fn2-extents (fn2-core-extents fn2-core))) (code epoch)
   (let ((next (+ 1 (max (nfix e0) (nfix e1)))))
    (if (and (unsigned-byte-p 60 next) (<= (abs (- (nfix e0) (nfix e1))) 1)
             (<= (fn2-alloc-current-epoch fn2-extents) next)) (mv :ok next) (mv :bounds 0)))
   (mv code epoch)))
 (defun fn2-boot-adopt-epoch (epoch fn2-core)
  (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-core :guard (fn2-core-wfp fn2-core)))
  (stobj-let ((fn2-extents (fn2-core-extents fn2-core))) (code fn2-extents)
   (cond ((not (unsigned-byte-p 60 epoch)) (mv :bounds fn2-extents))
         ((equal epoch (fn2-alloc-current-epoch fn2-extents)) (mv :ok fn2-extents))
         (t (fn2-alloc-begin-epoch epoch fn2-extents)))
   (mv code fn2-core)))
 (fn2-core-preserves fn2-boot-adopt-epoch (epoch fn2-core) :position 1 :rows nil)
 (defun fn2-boot-release-listener (index fn2-core)
  (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-core :guard (fn2-core-wfp fn2-core)))
  (if (and (natp index) (< index (fn2-machine-accept-count fn2-core)))
   (let ((target (+ index (fn2-machine-kind-base *fn2-listener-kind* fn2-core))))
    (mv (if (eq (fn2-listener-snapshot-read-code target fn2-core) :ok) :more :bounds) target fn2-core))
   (mv :ok *fn2-none* fn2-core)))
 (fn2-core-preserves fn2-boot-release-listener (index fn2-core) :position 2 :rows nil)
 (defun fn2-boot-release-windows (slot gen rx rgen id ogen fn2-core)
  (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-core :guard (fn2-core-wfp fn2-core)))
  (mv-let (code fn2-core) (fn2-core-release rx rgen *fn2-boot-kind* id ogen fn2-core)
   (if (member-eq code '(:ok :retired))
    (mv-let (code fn2-core) (fn2-core-release slot gen *fn2-boot-kind* id ogen fn2-core)
     (mv (if (member-eq code '(:ok :retired)) :ok code) fn2-core))
    (mv code fn2-core))))
 (fn2-core-preserves fn2-boot-release-windows (slot gen rx rgen id ogen fn2-core) :position 1 :rows nil)
 (in-theory (disable fn2-boot-pack fn2-boot-match fn2-boot-pop-config fn2-boot-read-epoch fn2-boot-check-anchor
                     fn2-boot-recover fn2-boot-recovered fn2-boot-select-epoch fn2-boot-adopt-epoch fn2-boot-release-listener
                     fn2-boot-release-windows))
 ))

(defmachine-arms fn2-boot :declare
 :arms
 ((:free (:idle))
  (:prepare :on-refusal ((:stop :configuration))
   (:do (code) (fn2-boot-pack (if (equal row-index 0) 0 1) row-index row-image-size 0
                            row-pool-slot row-pool-gen row-rx-slot row-rx-gen id row-generation))
   (:set (offset (+ row-base (* 4096 row-index))))
   (:if (equal row-create 1)
        ((:next :write) (:charge :bytes 12288 :steps *fn2-work-stage* :runnable t))
        ((:do (rcode) (fn2-core-reset row-rx-slot row-rx-gen))
         (:next :read) (:charge :bytes 12288 :steps *fn2-work-stage* :runnable t))))
  (:write :on-refusal ((:stop :io))
   (:if (not (and (natp budget) (< 0 budget))) ((:yield))
    ((:issue (fn2-issue-write row-offset row-pool-slot row-pool-gen 0 4096 0 :principal 0)
      :ok ((:set (pending 1) (event-ready 0)) (:next :write-result)
           (:charge :bytes 4096 :steps *fn2-work-small* :descriptors 1))))))
  (:write-result
   (:cond ((equal row-event-ready 0) (:idle))
          ((not (and (equal row-outcome *fn2-outcome-done*) (equal row-count 4096))) (:stop :io))
          ((equal row-stage 0) (:next :advance) (:charge :steps *fn2-work-small* :runnable t))
          ((equal row-stage 1) (:set (stage 2) (anchor-slot 1)) (:next :anchor) (:charge :steps *fn2-work-small* :runnable t))
          ((equal row-stage 2) (:next :recover) (:charge :steps *fn2-work-small* :runnable t))
          (t (:next :epoch-fence) (:charge :steps *fn2-work-small* :runnable t))))
  (:read :on-refusal ((:stop :io))
   (:if (not (and (natp budget) (< 0 budget))) ((:yield))
    ((:issue (fn2-issue-read row-offset row-rx-slot row-rx-gen 4096 :principal 0)
      :ok ((:set (pending 1) (event-ready 0)) (:next :read-result)
           (:charge :bytes 4096 :steps *fn2-work-small* :descriptors 1))))))
  (:read-result
   (:cond ((equal row-event-ready 0) (:idle))
          ((not (and (equal row-outcome *fn2-outcome-done*) (equal row-count 4096))) (:stop :io))
          (t (:next :verify) (:charge :steps *fn2-work-small* :runnable t))))
  (:verify :on-refusal ((:stop :anchor))
   (:if (equal row-stage 0)
    ((:do (code) (fn2-boot-match row-pool-slot row-pool-gen row-rx-slot row-rx-gen id row-generation)
      :case ((:otherwise (:stop :configuration))))
     (:next :advance) (:charge :bytes 8192 :steps *fn2-work-small* :runnable t))
    ((:do (code epoch) (fn2-boot-check-anchor row-anchor-slot row-image-size row-pool-slot row-pool-gen
                                            row-rx-slot row-rx-gen id row-generation))
     (:if (equal row-stage 1)
      ((:set (epoch0 epoch) (stage 2) (anchor-slot 1)) (:next :anchor)
       (:charge :bytes 24576 :steps *fn2-work-stage* :runnable t))
      ((:set (epoch1 epoch)) (:next :recover) (:charge :bytes 24576 :steps *fn2-work-stage* :runnable t))))))
  (:advance :on-refusal ((:stop :bounds))
   (:do (code) (fn2-boot-pop-config row-index))
   (:if (< row-index row-total)
    ((:set (index (+ 1 row-index))) (:next :prepare) (:charge :steps *fn2-work-small* :runnable t))
    ((:set (stage 1) (anchor-slot 0)) (:next :anchor) (:charge :steps *fn2-work-small* :runnable t))))
  (:anchor :on-refusal ((:stop :bounds))
   (:set (offset (+ (- row-image-size 8192) (* 4096 row-anchor-slot))))
   (:if (equal row-create 1)
    ((:do (code) (fn2-boot-pack 2 row-anchor-slot row-image-size 0 row-pool-slot row-pool-gen
                              row-rx-slot row-rx-gen id row-generation))
     (:next :write) (:charge :bytes 12288 :steps *fn2-work-stage* :runnable t))
    ((:do (code) (fn2-core-reset row-rx-slot row-rx-gen))
     (:next :read) (:charge :steps *fn2-work-small* :runnable t))))
  (:recover :on-refusal ((:stop :recovery))
   (:do (code target) (fn2-boot-recover))
   (:wake-row target)
   (:next :recover-wait) (:charge :steps *fn2-work-stage* :runnable t))
  (:recover-wait
   (:do (code) (fn2-boot-recovered) :accept ()
    :case (((:more) (:charge :steps *fn2-work-poll* :runnable t))
           ((:ok) (:next :epoch) (:charge :steps *fn2-work-small* :runnable t))
           (:otherwise (:stop :recovery)))))
  (:epoch :on-refusal ((:stop :epoch))
   (:do (code epoch) (fn2-boot-select-epoch row-epoch0 row-epoch1))
   (:let anchor (if (<= row-epoch0 row-epoch1) 0 1))
   (:do (pcode) (fn2-boot-pack 2 anchor row-image-size epoch row-pool-slot row-pool-gen
                             row-rx-slot row-rx-gen id row-generation))
   (:set (next-epoch epoch) (stage 3) (anchor-slot anchor) (offset (+ (- row-image-size 8192) (* 4096 anchor))))
   (:next :write) (:charge :bytes 12288 :steps *fn2-work-stage* :runnable t))
  (:epoch-fence :on-refusal ((:stop :io))
   (:if (not (and (natp budget) (< 0 budget))) ((:yield))
    ((:issue (fn2-issue-fence :principal 0)
      :ok ((:set (pending 1) (event-ready 0)) (:next :epoch-result)
           (:charge :steps *fn2-work-small* :descriptors 1))))))
  (:epoch-result :on-refusal ((:stop :epoch))
   (:cond ((equal row-event-ready 0) (:idle))
          ((not (equal row-outcome *fn2-outcome-done*)) (:stop :io))
          (t (:do (code) (fn2-boot-adopt-epoch row-next-epoch))
             (:do (rcode) (fn2-boot-release-windows row-pool-slot row-pool-gen row-rx-slot row-rx-gen id row-generation))
             (:set (release-index 0)) (:next :release) (:charge :steps *fn2-work-stage* :runnable t))))
  (:release :on-refusal ((:stop :bounds))
   (:do (code target) (fn2-boot-release-listener row-release-index) :accept ()
    :case (((:more) (:wake-row target) (:set (release-index (+ 1 row-release-index))) (:next :ready) (:charge :steps *fn2-work-small* :runnable t))
           ((:ok) (:next :ready) (:charge :steps *fn2-work-small*))
           (:otherwise (:stop :bounds)))))
  (:ready :on-refusal ((:stop :bounds))
   (:do (code target) (fn2-boot-release-listener row-release-index) :accept ()
    :case (((:more) (:wake-row target) (:set (release-index (+ 1 row-release-index))) (:charge :steps *fn2-work-small* :runnable t))
           ((:ok) (:idle)) (:otherwise (:stop :bounds)))))
  (:failed (:idle)))
 :observes
 ((:read-result (:set (event-ready 1) (outcome outcome) (count count)) (:wake))
  (:write-result (:set (event-ready 1) (outcome outcome) (count count)) (:wake))
  (:fence-result (:set (event-ready 1) (outcome outcome) (count count)) (:wake))))

(defmacro fn2-boot-events ()
 '(progn (fn2-boot-operations) (defmachine-arms fn2-boot) (defmachine-run fn2-boot)))
executor:
; Concrete dispatcher over the intrusive scheduler. No fusion.
(in-package "ACL2")
(include-book "checkpoint-working-credit-init")
(include-book "executor-wake")
(include-book "executor-services")
(include-book "assembly")
(include-book "executor-reservation")
(include-book "executor-loop-events")

(fn2-executor-loop-events)
(fn2-checkpoint-working-credit-init-events)

;; Genesis (MACHINE-FORM G3, C gap 5): each kind's :genesis arm runs once on
;; each of its rows at init, from the row's initial phase, so a row's first
;; writes and moves are an arm's; a runnable answer wakes the row. No turn is
;; running: the arm's charge is its bound, checked against the kind's caps at
;; defmachine-run, and nothing is charged. A directory row whose kind does not
;; read stops the core.
(defun fn2-exec-genesis-clauses (names code world)
  (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
  (if (atom names) nil
    (let ((gen (fn2-machine-property (car names) :genesis-arm world))
          (budget (fn2-machine-property (car names) :budget world)))
      (append (and gen
                   `((,code (mv-let (bytes steps descriptors runnable fn2-core)
                              (,(cadr (car gen)) id ,(nfix (fn2-arm-get :bytes budget)) fn2-core)
                              (declare (ignore bytes steps descriptors))
                              (if runnable (fn2-exec-wake id fn2-core) fn2-core)))))
              (fn2-exec-genesis-clauses (cdr names) (+ 1 code) world)))))
(make-event
 `(defun fn2-exec-genesis-row (id fn2-core)
    (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-core :guard (fn2-core-wfp fn2-core)))
    (if (not (eq (fn2-machine-kind-read-code id fn2-core) :ok))
        (fn2-core-stop *fn2-stop-reason-machine-phase* fn2-core)
      (if (and (equal (fn2-machine-kind id fn2-core) *fn2-listener-kind*)
               (eq (fn2-boot-snapshot-read-code (fn2-machine-kind-base *fn2-boot-kind* fn2-core) fn2-core) :ok))
          fn2-core
       (case (fn2-machine-kind id fn2-core)
        ,@(fn2-exec-genesis-clauses (fn2-machine-names (w state)) 0 (w state))
        (otherwise fn2-core))))))
(fn2-core-preserves fn2-exec-genesis-row (id fn2-core) :rows nil :prefix "")
(defun fn2-exec-genesis (left id fn2-core)
  (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-core :measure (nfix left)
                  :guard (and (fn2-core-wfp fn2-core) (natp left) (natp id))))
  (if (zp left) fn2-core
    (let ((fn2-core (fn2-exec-genesis-row id fn2-core)))
      (fn2-exec-genesis (- left 1) (+ 1 (nfix id)) fn2-core))))
(fn2-core-preserves fn2-exec-genesis (left id fn2-core) :rows nil :prefix "")
(defun fn2-exec-rows (fn2-core)
  (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-core :guard (fn2-core-wfp fn2-core)))
  (stobj-let ((fn2-machines (fn2-core-machines fn2-core))) (n) (fn2-machines-rows fn2-machines) n))

; Bookings the listeners hold (D7's S1): a listener with an Accept outstanding
; holds one :connection-row booking on its principal for the connection it is
; waiting for, so at quiescence a principal's hold is its live connections plus
; these (D 13.5). Read by D's checkers; the executor never calls it.
(defun fn2-listener-bookings-from (left id p fn2-core)
  (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-core :verify-guards nil :measure (nfix left)))
  (if (zp left) 0
    (+ (if (and (eq (fn2-machine-account-ref-read-code id fn2-core) :ok)
                (equal (fn2-machine-account-ref id fn2-core) p)) 1 0)
       (fn2-listener-bookings-from (- left 1) (+ 1 (nfix id)) p fn2-core))))
(defun fn2-listener-bookings (p fn2-core)
  (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-core :verify-guards nil))
  (fn2-listener-bookings-from (fn2-machine-accept-count fn2-core)
                              (fn2-machine-kind-base *fn2-listener-kind* fn2-core) p fn2-core))

;; Layer C's genesis (the profile's group directory, S-GROUP; the sealer's
;; seal row, C1c) right after the core init; a refusal stops the core before
;; anything runs.
(defun fn2-init-engine (profile fn2-core)
  (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-core :guard (fn2-core-wfp fn2-core)))
  (mv-let (genesis fn2-core) (fn2-engine-genesis profile fn2-core)
    (if (eq genesis :ok) fn2-core (fn2-core-stop *fn2-stop-reason-engine-genesis* fn2-core))))
(defthm fn2-init-engine-type
  (implies (and (fn2-corep fn2-core) (fn2-core-wfp fn2-core)) (fn2-corep (fn2-init-engine profile fn2-core))))
(defthm fn2-init-engine-wfp
  (implies (and (fn2-corep fn2-core) (fn2-core-wfp fn2-core)) (fn2-core-wfp (fn2-init-engine profile fn2-core))))
(in-theory (disable fn2-init-engine))

; The kind a listener admits a :local peer into (D 4.5): the profile's
; :listener-local-target when it names one, else its :listener-targets.
(defun fn2-listener-local-target-name (profile)
  (declare (xargs :guard t))
  (if (and (alistp profile) (assoc-equal :listener-local-target profile))
      (fn2-profile-get :listener-local-target profile)
    (fn2-profile-get :listener-targets profile)))

(defun fn2-init-credit-boundary (profile fn2-core)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-core :guard (fn2-core-wfp fn2-core)))
 (if (not (fn2-profile-get :image-boot profile)) (mv :ok fn2-core)
  (if (not (fn2-profilep profile)) (mv :profile fn2-core)
   (fn2-checkpoint-working-credit-init profile fn2-core))))
(fn2-core-preserves fn2-init-credit-boundary (profile fn2-core) :position 1 :rows nil)

(defun fn2-init-executor (profile mode scribe-p fn2-core)
  (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-core :guard (fn2-core-profilep profile)
    :guard-hints (("Goal" :use
      (:instance fn2-machine-kind-base-natp (kind *fn2-listener-kind*)
        (fn2-core (fn2-listener-set-mode-all (if (eq mode :null) 0 1)
                    (fn2-init-engine profile
                     (mv-nth 1 (fn2-init-credit-boundary profile (fn2-core-init profile fn2-core)))))))))))
  (b* ((fn2-core (fn2-core-init profile fn2-core))
       ((mv credit fn2-core) (fn2-init-credit-boundary profile fn2-core))
       ((unless (eq credit :ok)) (fn2-core-stop *fn2-stop-reason-engine-genesis* fn2-core))
       (fn2-core (fn2-init-engine profile fn2-core))
       (fn2-core (fn2-listener-set-mode-all (if (eq mode :null) 0 1) fn2-core))
       (fn2-core (fn2-listener-set-target-all
                  (fn2-machine-admission-ordinal-of (fn2-profile-get :listener-targets profile))
                  (fn2-machine-admission-ordinal-of (fn2-listener-local-target-name profile))
                  fn2-core))
       (fn2-core (fn2-listener-set-principals (fn2-profile-get :listener-principals profile) fn2-core))
       (fn2-core (fn2-exec-genesis (fn2-exec-rows fn2-core) 0 fn2-core))
       (fn2-core (if scribe-p (fn2-scribe-start fn2-core) fn2-core))
       ((mv wake fn2-core) (fn2-machine-take-wake fn2-core)))
    (fn2-exec-wake wake fn2-core)))

; The supplied genesis configuration is staged only in volatile C rows.
; On an image boot it cannot serve until the boot machine has matched every
; persisted genesis unit, recovered/replayed the journal and fenced its epoch.
(defun fn2-image-profile (profile)
 (declare (xargs :guard t))
 (put-assoc-equal :image-boot t (if (alistp profile) profile nil)))

(defun fn2-image-sizep (size extents groups)
 (declare (xargs :guard t))
 (and (unsigned-byte-p 60 size) (equal (mod size 4096) 0)
      (unsigned-byte-p 32 extents) (posp extents) (unsigned-byte-p 32 groups)
      (<= (+ (* 12288 extents) (* 4096 (+ groups 3))) size)))

(defun fn2-image-create-request (size profile)
 (declare (xargs :guard t))
 (if (fn2-image-sizep size (fn2-b-capacity :extent-slots 16 profile)
                      (len (fn2-profile-get :groups profile))) :ok :geometry))

(defun fn2-boot-start (create size fn2-core)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-core :guard (fn2-core-wfp fn2-core)))
 (b* ((id (fn2-machine-kind-base *fn2-boot-kind* fn2-core))
      ((unless (and (eq (fn2-boot-snapshot-read-code id fn2-core) :ok)
                    (equal (fn2-machine-phase id fn2-core) *fn2-boot-state-free*)
                    (unsigned-byte-p 60 size) (equal (mod size 4096) 0)))
       (mv :geometry fn2-core))
      ((mv base total) (stobj-let ((fn2-boot-config (fn2-core-boot-config fn2-core))) (base total)
                        (mv (* 12288 (nfix (fn2-boot-config-extents fn2-boot-config)))
                            (fn2-boot-config-count fn2-boot-config)) (mv base total)))
      ((unless (fn2-image-sizep size (/ base 12288) total)) (mv :geometry fn2-core))
      (gen (fn2-machine-generation id fn2-core))
      (class (stobj-let ((fn2-pool (fn2-core-pool fn2-core))) (class) (fn2-pool-class-for 4096 fn2-pool) class))
      ((unless class) (mv :window fn2-core))
      ((mv code slot sgen fn2-core) (fn2-core-reserve class *fn2-boot-kind* id gen fn2-core))
      ((unless (and (eq code :ok) (unsigned-byte-p 32 slot) (unsigned-byte-p 60 sgen))) (mv :window fn2-core))
      ((mv code rx rgen fn2-core) (fn2-core-reserve class *fn2-boot-kind* id gen fn2-core))
      ((unless (and (eq code :ok) (unsigned-byte-p 32 rx) (unsigned-byte-p 60 rgen))) (mv :window fn2-core))
      (fn2-core (fn2-boot-put-core id (phase *fn2-boot-state-prepare*)
                  (pool-slot slot) (pool-gen sgen) (rx-slot rx) (rx-gen rgen)
                  (create (if create 1 0)) (image-size size) (base base) (total total)
                  (index 0) (stage 0) (epoch0 0) (epoch1 0) (principal-slot 0)))
      ((mv code fn2-core) (fn2-recovery-ready id fn2-core)))
  (mv (if (member-eq code '(:ok :already)) :ok :bounds) fn2-core)))
(fn2-core-preserves fn2-boot-start (create size fn2-core) :position 1 :rows nil)

(defun fn2-boot-status (fn2-core)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-core :guard (fn2-core-wfp fn2-core)))
 (let ((id (fn2-machine-kind-base *fn2-boot-kind* fn2-core)))
  (cond ((not (eq (fn2-boot-snapshot-read-code id fn2-core) :ok)) :disabled)
        ((not (equal (fn2-core-stop-reason fn2-core) 0)) :failed)
        ((equal (fn2-machine-phase id fn2-core) *fn2-boot-state-ready*) :ready)
        (t :booting))))

(defthm-owed fn2-turn-bounds (core)
  (implies (and (fn2-corep core) (fn2-core-wfp core))
    (mv-let (status nobs nvisits nactions after) (fn2-turn core)
      (declare (ignore status after))
      (and (<= nobs (fn2-exec-h core)) (<= nvisits (fn2-exec-k core))
           (<= nactions (fn2-exec-aturn core)))))
  :schema :bound :from (:operation fn2-turn)
  :teeth (fn2-executor-bounds-teeth fn2-executor-bounds-negative)
  :doc "Owed simultaneous observation, calendar-visit and descriptor bounds over fn2-turn.")

; The turn bound as composition (HIGHER-STRUCTURES entry 9): a word of
; machine runs, each charged within its arm's certificate, costs at most the
; sum of the arms' declared bounds; T3's bound is this lemma's instance with
; at most K runs. Its partner is the residual budget: a run handed the turn's
; remaining descriptor budget never spends more than it (Lawvere's
; spent + c <= A iff c <= A - spent, with truncated subtraction covering
; exhaustion: an exhausted budget admits only zero-descriptor runs).
; A word element is (kind phase bytes steps descriptors).
(defun fn2-arm-word-certified-p (word)
  (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
  (if (atom word) t
    (and (true-listp (car word)) (equal (len (car word)) 5)
         (fn2-machine-arm-charge-ok-p (nth 0 (car word)) (nth 1 (car word))
                                      (nth 2 (car word)) (nth 3 (car word)) (nth 4 (car word)))
         (fn2-arm-word-certified-p (cdr word)))))
(defun fn2-arm-word-charge (word)
  (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
  (if (atom word) 0
    (+ (nfix (and (consp (car word)) (nth 2 (car word))))
       (nfix (and (consp (car word)) (nth 3 (car word))))
       (fn2-arm-word-charge (cdr word)))))
(defun fn2-arm-word-bound (word)
  (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
  (if (atom word) 0
    (+ (nfix (and (consp (car word)) (fn2-machine-arm-bound (nth 0 (car word)) (nth 1 (car word)))))
       (fn2-arm-word-bound (cdr word)))))
(defthm-owed fn2-arm-cost-composition (word)
  (implies (fn2-arm-word-certified-p word)
           (<= (fn2-arm-word-charge word) (fn2-arm-word-bound word)))
  :schema :bound :from (:operation fn2-turn)
  :teeth (fn2-arm-composition-positive fn2-arm-composition-negative)
  :doc "Runs charged within their arm certificates compose: the word's bytes and steps are at most the sum of its arms' declared bounds.")

; The executor's case source (DSL-METATHEORY 3.2): the executor is not a
; machine; it contributes seven labels with named selectors over the core in
; which fn2-transition runs with observations allowed. Selectors are
; proof-facing (non-executable); that they partition the non-machine
; transitions under the loop invariant is owed by the correspondence.
(defun-nx fn2-exec-select-clock (fn2-core)
  (and (fn2-exec-observation-p fn2-core) (not (fn2-core-posted-p fn2-core))
       (equal (fn2-ops-clock-posted (fn2-core-ops fn2-core)) 1)))

  (and (fn2-exec-observation-p fn2-core) (not (fn2-core-posted-p fn2-core))
       (not (equal (fn2-ops-clock-posted (fn2-core-ops fn2-core)) 1))))
(defun-nx fn2-exec-select-visit (kind fn2-core)
  (and (not (fn2-exec-observation-p fn2-core)) (fn2-exec-eligible-p fn2-core)
       (mv-let (visit principal position core) (fn2-exec-visit fn2-core)
         (declare (ignore position))
         (and (equal visit kind)
              (or (not (equal kind *fn2-visit-principal*))
                  (mv-let (code id core) (fn2-exec-pop principal core)
                    (declare (ignore id core)) (not (eq code :ok))))))))
(defun-nx fn2-exec-select-service-0 (fn2-core) (fn2-exec-select-visit *fn2-visit-commit* fn2-core))
(defun-nx fn2-exec-select-service-1 (fn2-core) (fn2-exec-select-visit *fn2-visit-timer* fn2-core))
(defun-nx fn2-exec-select-service-2 (fn2-core) (fn2-exec-select-visit *fn2-visit-notification* fn2-core))
(defun-nx fn2-exec-select-service-3 (fn2-core) (fn2-exec-select-visit *fn2-visit-maintenance* fn2-core))
(defun-nx fn2-exec-select-empty-principal (fn2-core)

                    (:executor :empty-principal))
            :selectors (((:executor :clock) fn2-exec-select-clock)

                        ((:executor :service 0) fn2-exec-select-service-0)
                        ((:executor :service 1) fn2-exec-select-service-1)
                        ((:executor :service 2) fn2-exec-select-service-2)
                        ((:executor :service 3) fn2-exec-select-service-3)
